info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Miargyri Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Miargyri Recliner Detail API facilitates the creation of detailed catalog entries for the Miargyri recliner product. By using this endpoint, businesses can input specifications, features, and visual content to enhance product visibility and customer engagement. This API is designed for e-commerce platforms or retail systems looking to enrich their product catalog with comprehensive data. Typical consumers of this API include product managers and developers responsible for maintaining product inventories.

post.summary: Create or update details for the Miargyri recliner.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create new or update existing details for the Miargyri recliner. Ensure all required fields are filled correctly for successful operation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide details for the Miargyri recliner. The data submitted should adhere to the specified schema to ensure successful processing of the request.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the recliner details.
